Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address DORP WORKSHOP DRDL KANCHANBAGH HYDERABAD TELANGANA STATE . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the

bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Generic The successful bidder has to supply all essential accessories required for the successful installation and commissioning of the goods supplied. Besides standard accessories as per normal industry practice, following accessories must be part of supply and cost should be included in bid price: WITH REQUIRED ACCESSORIES . 8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 11. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 12. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) 1. Submission of Documents with Technical Bid The bidder shall upload the following documents, duly signed and stamped with the company seal, along w ith the Technical Bid: a. All techno-commercial documents attached with the bid, including but not limited to: Technical Specifications Scope of Work (SOW) Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) Vendor Qualification Criteria (VQC) b. The GeM Bid Document, including the Checklist and these Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC), whereve r applicable, as confirmation of acceptance of all bid requirements. c. Any other document forming part of the bid. Submission of the above documents is mandatory for technical evaluation. Failure to submit any of the req

uired documents may result in rejection of the bid during the techno-commercial evaluation. 2. Bank Guarantee The successful bidder shall submit the required Bank Guarantee within 30 days from the date of placeme nt of the Purchase Order, as per the contract terms. Failure to submit the Bank Guarantee within the stipul ated period may result in cancellation of the contract. 3. Authorized Source Requirement The subject items/fabrication work pertain to M/s Plasma Spray Processors, Mumbai Accordingly, quot ations shall be accepted only from M/s Plasma Spray Processors , Mumbai. Quotations received from any other firm shall be treated as non-responsive and rejected. 4. Delivery Schedule The successful bidder shall deliver the items only on working days (Monday to Friday) between 09:30 AM and 04:30 PM. Prior coordination before delivery is mandatory. For delivery-related coordination, please contact: 040-24583248 040-24583296 5. Timely Delivery The successful bidder shall commence the supply/fabrication work immediately upon receipt of the GeM S upply Order and complete the work within the agreed delivery schedule. Deliveries at or near the last perm issible date should be avoided, as they may lead to rejection of the supplies and may adversely affect the s eller's performance rating. 6. Documents to Accompany the Supply The following documents shall accompany each delivery, wherever applicable: Copy of the Contract/Purchase Order Copy of the approved Delivery Period (DP) amendment, if applicable Tax Invoice/GeM Invoice Warranty Certificate Certificate of Conformance/Compliance Calibration Certificate Any other document specified in the contract 7. Bid Security Declaration (BSD) The bidder shall submit the Bid Security Declaration (BSD) Form along with the bid, wherever applicable. F ailure to submit the BSD Form may result in rejection of the bid. 8. Inspection The supplied items/fabrication work shall be inspected by R&QA, DRDL after delivery and before accepta nce. 9. Delivery Period The successful bidder shall complete the supply of the items and/or fabrication work within four (4) mont hs from the date of placement of the GeM Supply Order. 10. Jurisdiction Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this contract shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Hyderabad. 11. Lot-wise Delivery The successful bidder shall deliver the items or complete the fabrication work in Two (2) lots, as per the d elivery schedule agreed with the purchaser. 12. Payment Terms

The bidder shall raise separate invoices for each of the three delivery lots. Payment shall be processed by the DRDL Payment Authority on a lot-wise basis after successful delivery, inspection, acceptance of the res pective lot, and submission of all required documents, in accordance with the GeM contract terms. . 14.
